chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 337: Dead City Descends, Stone Man Awakens
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen enters the Dead City to confront half-ancestors. The ancestral song mourns forgotten heroes, and the stone man within him rises.
og_title: The Dead City and the Ancestral Song – World of Immortality Ch. 337
og_description: The Dead City descends, half-ancestors are summoned by the death knell, and Xiao Chen weeps as the ancestor Youchao's corpse merges with the Yellow Clay Altar.
twitter_title: Ch. 337: The Ancestral Song – World of Immortality
twitter_description: King Wen of Zhou appears, the Dead City manifests, and a mournful song echoes the forgotten ancestors. Xiao Chen's stone man awakens.
